entries.title: Jeremiah 30:1
segments: ¶The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:2
segments: Thus speaketh the LORD God of Israel, saying, Write thee all the words that I have spoken unto thee in a book.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:3
segments: For, lo, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will bring again the captivity of my people Israel and Judah, saith the LORD: and I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they shall possess it.

words.text: : and I will cause them to return

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:4
segments: And these [are] the words that the LORD spake concerning Israel and concerning Judah.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:5
segments: For thus saith the LORD; We have heard a voice of trembling, of fear, and not of peace. {of fear...: or, there is fear, and not peace}

words.text: . {of fear...: or, there is fear, and not peace}

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:6
segments: Ask ye now, and see whether a man doth travail with child? wherefore do I see every man with his hands on his loins, as a woman in travail, and all faces are turned into paleness? {a man: Heb. a male}

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:7
segments: Alas! for that day [is] great, so that none [is] like it: it [is] even the time of Jacob's trouble; but he shall be saved out of it.

words.text: none [is] like it: it [is] even the time

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:8
segments: For it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD of hosts, [that] I will break his yoke from off thy neck, and will burst thy bonds, and strangers shall no more serve themselves of him:

words.text: For it shall come to pass in that day

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:9
segments: But they shall serve the LORD their God, and David their king, whom I will raise up unto them.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:10
segments: ¶Therefore fear thou not, O my servant Jacob, saith the LORD; neither be dismayed, O Israel: for, lo, I will save thee from afar, and thy seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and shall be in rest, and be quiet, and none shall make [him] afraid.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:11
segments: For I [am] with thee, saith the LORD, to save thee: though I make a full end of all nations whither I have scattered thee, yet will I not make a full end of thee: but I will correct thee in measure, and will not leave thee altogether unpunished.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:12
segments: For thus saith the LORD, Thy bruise [is] incurable, [and] thy wound [is] grievous.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:13

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:14
segments: All thy lovers have forgotten thee; they seek thee not; for I have wounded thee with the wound of an enemy, with the chastisement of a cruel one, for the multitude of thine iniquity; [because] thy sins were increased.

words.text: thee not; for I have wounded

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:15
segments: Why criest thou for thine affliction? thy sorrow [is] incurable for the multitude of thine iniquity: [because] thy sins were increased, I have done these things unto thee.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:16
segments: Therefore all they that devour thee shall be devoured; and all thine adversaries, every one of them, shall go into captivity; and they that spoil thee shall be a spoil, and all that prey upon thee will I give for a prey.

words.text: , every one of them, shall go

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:17
segments: For I will restore health unto thee, and I will heal thee of thy wounds, saith the LORD; because they called thee an Outcast, [saying], This [is] Zion, whom no man seeketh after.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:18
segments: ¶Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will bring again the captivity of Jacob's tents, and have mercy on his dwellingplaces; and the city shall be builded upon her own heap, and the palace shall remain after the manner thereof. {heap: or, little hill}

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:19
segments: And out of them shall proceed thanksgiving and the voice of them that make merry: and I will multiply them, and they shall not be few; I will also glorify them, and they shall not be small.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:20
segments: Their children also shall be as aforetime, and their congregation shall be established before me, and I will punish all that oppress them.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:21
segments: And their nobles shall be of themselves, and their governor shall proceed from the midst of them; and I will cause him to draw near, and he shall approach unto me: for who [is] this that engaged his heart to approach unto me? saith the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:23
segments: Behold, the whirlwind of the LORD goeth forth with fury, a continuing whirlwind: it shall fall with pain upon the head of the wicked. {continuing: Heb. cutting} {fall...: or, remain}

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:24
segments: The fierce anger of the LORD shall not return, until he have done [it], and until he have performed the intents of his heart: in the latter days ye shall consider it.
